rationale: The agent appeared to authenticate the user via name and ZIP (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and acted on the user’s own order (#W4073673). However, it performed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user, which violates the stated policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing action. The final message announces that the exchange has already been submitted. Additionally, the agent stated a specific refund amount and card details; while these might be supported by tool results, they weren’t explicitly shown. The lack of pre-action confirmation alone is sufficient to fail under the policy. Hence, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
